en: O Queen of all the gods, I do not certainly speak highly of my own self. See now, O lady of slender waist, what I do. Look at the Being that I will create, O you of the fairest complexion, for destroying this Sacrifice, O my beautiful wife!

sa: सपुत्रदाराः सामात्या भर्तृव्यसनपीडिताः। शैलाग्रेभ्यः पतिष्यन्ति समेषु विषमेषु च॥
en: They, along with their sons and wives, and counsellors, distressed on account the disaster that has overtaken their master, shall fall from the tops of mountains down to places even or uneven.

sa: ततो द्रुतं मद्रजनाधिपो रणे युधिष्ठिरं सप्तभिरभ्यविद्ध्यत्। विव्याध राजंस्तुमुले महात्मा॥
en: They king of the Madras at this time quickly struck Yudhishthira with seven arrows in that battle. The great son of Pritha. O king, in return, struck his foe with nine arrows in that dreadful battle.

sa: तयोर्धनातलनिःस्वनो महान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यनि:स्वनः। परस्परं बाणगणैर्महात्मनोः प्रवर्षतोर्मद्रपपाण्डुवीरयोः॥
en: The loud noise of their bows, bowstrings and palms, resembled that of Indra's thunder as those great car-warriors showered upon each other innumerable arrows.

sa: पद्भ्यां तु शैलमाविध्य वडवामुखवन्मुखम्। विवृत्योग्रं ननादोच्वैस्वासयन्रजनीचरान्।॥
en: And hurting the mountain with his tread, he, opening wide his mouth resembling that of a mare, sent up loud shouts, terrifying the nightrangers.

sa: किमत्र चित्रं धर्मज्ञ लोकनाथशिखामणे। यत्त्वमार्य प्रभाषेथाः सत्त्ववान्सत्पथे स्थितः॥
en: What wonder is there that you wouldst speak these auspicious words, O you the foremost of kings, conversant with morality, gifted with prowess and ever treading the pious track as you are.

sa: ततस्तु ते राक्षसपुङ्गवास्त्रयो निशाचरैः पुत्रशतैश्च संवृता। सुरान्सहेन्द्रानृषिनागयक्षान् बबाधिरे तान्बहुवीर्यदर्पिताः॥
en: And those three foremost of Rākṣasa, accompanied by hundreds of sons night rangers all-elated on account of their measureless prowess, began to worry the sages and serpents and Yakşas, and celestials with Indra (at their head).

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता। सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना॥
en: At this time passed by that way the foremost of Apsarās, Rambhā, adorned with excellent ornaments and having a countenance like the full moon.

sa: आतिष्ठ धर्मज्ञ मया सहेमां गां पूर्वराजाध्युषितां बलेन। तैयौँवराज्ये दुरमुद्वहस्व॥
en: O you conversant with piety, do you with me and four fold forces, govern this kingdom, ruled by our predecessors. Like to our ancestors do you now carry the burden of an associate in the throne.

sa: पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यं चैवान्ववर्तत। तस्थौ चोर्ध्वशिरोबाहुः स्वाध्याये धृतमानसः॥
en: And for five thousand years, he adored the Sun, and with his mind concentrated in the study of the Veda, remained with his head and hands raised up.

sa: उत्पेततुस्तदा तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम्। भुजैश्चिक्षिपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥
en: Then rising up speedily they again assailed each other. Thus those two heroes unsubdued, struck each other with their arms.

sa: बहून्यप्रतिरूपाणि वचनानि सुदुर्मते। अनुक्रोशान्मृदुत्वाच्च सोढानि तव मैथिलि॥
en: O foolish daughter of the king of Mithilā, we have put up with all your foolish words only out of compassion, and because you are a feeble being.

sa: अप्राप्तामेव तां बाणैत्रिभिश्चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः। अथोदतिष्ठत्संनादो वानराणां महारणे॥
en: Ere the dart had reached its destination, Laks mana severed it with three shafts; and thereat in that mighty conflict there arose a mighty uproar from the monkeys.

sa: अङ्गदं संप्रधावन्ति प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः॥ ततो हरिगणान्भग्नान्दृष्ट्वा वालिसुतस्तदा। क्रोधेन वज्रदंष्ट्र तमुदीक्षन्तमुदैक्षत॥
en: Thereat terrified, the monkeys, with their bodies cut with arrows, rushed towards Angada, like creatures resorting to the Creator. And finding the monkeys ranks disordered, Vāli's son in a range cast his eyes on Vajradaństra, who also was eyeing him.

sa: वरव्याजेन मोहोऽस्मै दीयताममितप्रभ॥ लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्याद्भवेदस्य च संमतिः।
en: Do you then, o lord having immeasurable prowess, pretending to give him a boon, give stupefaction (instead). Thereby the welfare of the people would be secured, and the honour of this one too shall be maintained.

sa: वरुणश्च वरं प्रादानास्य मृत्युभविष्यति। वर्षायुतशतेनापि भत्पाशादुदकादपि॥
en: Varuņa bestowed upon him the boon that he well not die for hundred ayuta years even from the my noose (Pasa) or waters either.

sa: तस्य च व्यसनाभावाद्व्यसनं चागते त्वयि। धर्मो भवत्यधर्मश्च परस्परविरोधिनौ॥
en: Seeing that he is free from danger, and you are in itrighteousness and its opposite are found to have tendencles the very reverse of those assigned to them respectively (by the Vedas).

sa: सोऽयमर्थं परित्यज्य सुखकामः सुखैधितः। पापमाचरते कतु तदा दोष प्रवर्तते॥
en: He that renouncing riches, within his reach,* hankers after enjoyment, being carried away by his overmastering desire, take to getting at wealth by sinful acts; and then he incur guilt. *The commentator would have gotten riches.'

sa: नैषामकृतकार्याणामीदृशः स्याद् व्यतिक्रमः। वनं यदभिपन्नास्ते साधितं कर्म तद्धवम्॥
en: They would not have engaged in such an unfair proceeding had they been unsuccessful in their mission. They have surely achieved success while they have thus been bent upon devastating the orchard.

sa: मलमण्डनदिग्धाङ्गी मण्डनार्हाममण्डनाम्। मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति न विभाति च॥
en: Her limbs, where he used to wear ornaments, were covered with dirt and albeit worthy of ornaments, appeared without any like to a lotus covered with clay and therefore shining very indistinctly.

sa: यस्यार्था धर्मकामार्थास्तस्य सर्व प्रदक्षिणम्। अधनेनार्थकामेन नार्थः शक्यं विचिन्वता॥
en: He that has riches, has virtue and desire attending on him, and has everything auspicious. That one without wealth, that seek it, cannot secure the wealth of prowess, without riches and desire.

sa: अक्षयाविषुधी बाणैश्चापं चापि सुदुर्जयम्। अस्त्रं च बलवद्राजञ्छत्रुविध्वंसनं रणे॥
en: Besides he has obtained a quiver, the arrows whereof shall never be exhausted, a bow, which is hard of being got by and a dreadful weapon which destroys enemies in a conflict.

sa: युष्मत्तो भयभीतानां देवानां वै मयाभयम्। राक्षसोत्सादनं दत्तं तदेतदनुपाल्यते॥
en: I have removed the fear of the deities, affrighted at you, by promising that I will make root and branch work with the Räkşasas; and that same promise I am now fulfilling.

sa: अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्म प्रहस्तो रथमाश्रितः। चकार कदनं घोरं धनुष्पाणिर्वनौकसाम्॥
en: And not brooking that feat, Prahasta, mounted on a car, taking a bow in his hand, fell to spreading a dreadful havoc among the rangers of the woods.

sa: आवर्त इव संजज्ञे सेनयोरुभयोस्तदा। क्षुभितस्याप्रमेमस्य सागरस्येव नि:स्वनः॥
en: Then there the two hosts mingled into almost a vortex; and the sounds that arose from those infuriated once of immeasurable might, resembled the roar of the ocean.

sa: तयोर्मध्ये कपिश्रेष्ठः क्षोणिताश्रप्रजङ्घयोः। विशाखयोर्मध्यगतः पूर्णचन्द्र इवाबभौ॥
en: And placed between those two Soņitākşa and Prajangha-that foremost of monkeys appeared like the full moon placed between the Visākhās.* *The asterisks so named

sa: प्रेक्षतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तान्यनीकानि भागशः। राघवप्रियकामार्थ लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा॥
en: And for doing what was dear to Rāma, that army, divided into separate parties, in the presence of the Raksasa chief commenced scaling Lanka.

sa: ऊचुः सुरासुराः सर्वे तदा विग्रहमागताः। प्रेक्षमाणा महायुद्धं वाक्यं भक्त्या प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: As they looked on the mighty encounter, the celestials and the Asuras, who had come to the conflict, from feeling of regard,* Cheerfully spoke (these words). *i.e. each party out of regard for the warrior to whom it wished well.

sa: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः। विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा॥
en: Action on the very eve of success, on being obstructed by adverse season and place, and through the agency of unreflecting envoys come to nought, even as darkness is dispelled on sunrise.

sa: हस्त्यध्यक्षैर्गजैर्मुक्तैर्मुक्तैश्च तुरगैरपि।। बभूव लङ्का लोकान्ते भ्रान्तग्राह इवार्णवः॥
en: With elephant-riders, and elephants, and steeds let loose, Lankä appeared like the Ocean at the hour of Universal tumbling, with its ferocious aquatic animals whirling in wild chaos.

sa: संख्ये प्रहस्तं निहतं निशम्य क्रोधार्दितः शोकपरीतचेताः। निन्द्रो यथा निर्जरयूथमुख्यान्॥
en: And hearing that Prahasta had been killed in battle (he), exercised with passion, with his heart influenced with grief, addressed those foremost of the Raksasas host, even as Indra addressed the chiefs among the celestials, saying

sa: महौषध्यस्ततः सर्वास्तस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे। विज्ञायार्थिनमायान्तं ततो जग्मुरदर्शनम्॥
en: Those potent medicines, in that foremost of mountains, knowing (before-hand) that one was coming seeking for them, rendered themselves invisible.

sa: अङ्गहारैस्तथैवान्या कोमलैर्नृत्यशालिनी। विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी प्रसुप्ता वरवर्णिनी॥
en: And another transcendentally beautiful damsel possessed of lovely limbs, skilled in dance, was fast asleep, betraying comely movement (during sleep).

sa: स इति सवितृसूनुस्तत्र तत्कर्म कृत्वा पवनगतिरनीकं प्राविशत्संप्रहृष्टः। रघुवरनृपसूनोर्वर्धयन्युद्धहर्ष तरुमृगगणमुख्यैः पूज्यमानो हरीन्द्रः॥
en: Having done that deed, the son of the Sun, lord of monkeys-with his heart surcharged with rejoicing, entered that host having the speed of the wind; enhancing the martial ardour of the son of the foremost of the Raghus, and honoured by the monkeys.

sa: कुण्डलाभ्यां शुभाभ्यां तु भ्राजन्मुखविकासितम्। केयूरनिष्काभरणं रक्तमालावलम्बिनम्॥
en: His beautiful countenance was adorned with a pair of excellent Kundalas; and his person was embellished with Keyūras, Nişkas and garlands of red lotuses.

sa: दशाननस्तं कपिमन्ववेक्ष्य। अथोपविष्टान् कुलशीलवृद्धन् समादिशत् तं प्रतिमुख्यमन्त्री॥
en: And with his reddened eyes rolling, the tennecked one, gazing at that monkey, ordered his principal counsellors, boasting of high pedigree and noble character, (to interrogate the incomer).

sa: विसर्जयित्वा सचिवांस्ततस्तान् गतेषु रक्षःसु यथानियोगम्। व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौधं महाझषः पूर्णमिवार्णवौघम्॥
en: Then leaving those counsellors, (Ravana) on the Raksasa having departed agreeably to his injunction, dived into that ocean of monkeys, like a mighty fish diving into the waves of over brimming deep.

sa: अवध्योऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा तमस्त्रेणास्त्रतत्त्ववित्। निजग्राह महाबाहुं मारुतात्मजमिन्द्रजित्॥
en: And knowing him incapable of being slain, Indrajit conversant with the use of weapons, bound that large-armed son of the Wind-god with that weapon.

sa: एकया दीर्घया वेण्या शोभमानामयत्नतः। नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥
en: A long lock of dark-blue hair, taken not the least care of, was on her back; and with this she appeared like to the earth covered with dark-blue forests at the expiration of the rainy season.

sa: तदधर्मिष्ठसंयोगानिवर्त कुलदूषणात्॥ चिन्त्यते हि वधोपायः सर्षिसङ्घः सुरैस्तव।
en: Do you then desist from this impious course, tending to sully your line. The celestials along with the sages are pondering over the means of compassing your death.

sa: यातु वानरवाहिन्या वानरः प्लवतां पतिः। पालयन्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमृषभो वानरर्षभः॥ गन्धहस्तीव दुर्धर्षस्तरस्वी गन्धमादनः। यातु वानरवाहिन्याः सव्यं पार्श्वमधिष्ठितः॥
en: And let that foremost of monkeys, Rşabha, go, protecting the right wing (of the army); and let Gandha, irresistible like an elephant with the fragrant temporal juice trickling down, and the vehement Gandhamādana, go,* protecting the left wing (of the monkey-army). *The verb is singular, instead of dual, as also the qualifying epithet, Pārsamadishthita. But the sense is clear. on

sa: इन्द्रजित्स रथं दिव्यमाश्रितश्चित्रकार्मुकः। धनुर्विस्फारयामास तडिदूर्जितनिः स्वनम्॥
en: And Indrajit too, seated on the celestial car and having a painted bow, began to stretch it, emitting a sound resembling that of thunder.

sa: रावणोऽपि महातेजाः कपिलाघवविस्मितः। अस्त्रमाहारयामास दीप्ताग्नेयमद्भुतम्॥
en: Rāvana also endowed with exceeding energy, astonished at the lightness of the monkey, took up a wonderful flaming fiery weapon.

sa: स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं सौमित्रिमित्रनन्दनः। राक्षसेन्द्रबलं दूरादपश्यद्व्यूहमाश्रितम्॥
en: Having proceeded far, Sumitra's Sumitra's son-enhancer of the delight of friends, from a distance discovered the forces of the Rākşasmonarch, drawn up in battle-array.

sa: विसंजं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः। रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे॥
en: Seeing the monkey deprived of his senses, the Ten-necked one, eager for encounter, riding a car emitting a rattle resembling the rumbling of clouds, darted against Sumitra's son.

sa: सर्वं चैतद्विनाशाय राक्षसानामुपस्थितम्। काले कालगृहीतानां नक्षत्रं ग्रहपीडितम्॥
en: All this is for the destruction of the Rākşasas. At the fated time, those that are in the clutches of Death, have their stars afflicted by the planets.

sa: स लक्ष्मणश्चापि शिताशिताग्रान् महेन्द्रतुल्योऽशनिभीमवेगान्। संधाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्ज रक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय॥
en: Laksmana also, resembling Indra the Great, setting on his bow sharpened, sharp-pointed, flaming, and luminous shafts, endowed with the dreadful vehement impetus of the thunder-bolt, discharged (them) to compass the destruction of the lord of Räkşasa.

sa: तेऽन्योऽन्यमभि सर्पन्तो निनदन्तश्च विस्वरम्। राक्षसेन्द्रास्त्रनिर्भिन्ना निपेतुर्वानरर्षभाः।
en: They foremost of Vānaras, pierced by the missiles of the lord of Raksasas gliding towards one another and crying bitterly fell down on earth.

sa: कोपाद्विजृम्भमाणस्य वक्राव्यक्तमिव ज्वलन्। उत्पपात सधूमाग्निवृत्रस्य वदनादिव॥
en: As he kept yawning in passion, a flaming fire with smoke darted from his mouth, even as it did from the mouth of Vſtra.

sa: अथ मौर्वीस्वनं कृत्वा भगवान्भूतभावनः। मालिनं प्रति बाणौघान्ससर्जासिगदाधरः॥
en: Then that creator of all beings, the reverend Gadādhara,* twanging his bow-string, showered volleys of shafts on Máli. *Lit. the holder of the mace, a name of Visnu.

sa: कपिस्ततस्तं रणचण्डविक्रम प्रवृद्धतेजोबलवीर्यसायकम्। कुमारमक्षं प्रसमीक्ष्य संयुगे ननाद हर्षाद्धनतुल्यनिःस्वनः॥
en: Then the monkey, having sounds like those of clouds, beholding in battle Akşa of terrific prowess in conflict, and strong in energy, strength and shafts, sent up shouts from elation of spirits.

sa: स तस्य वीरः सुमुखान्पतत्रिणः सुवर्णपङ्खान्सविषानिवोरगान्। च्छरानथ त्रीन्कपिमूर्ध्यताडयत्॥
en: That hero, skilled in aiming, fixing and discharging arrows, shot at the monkey's head three fine-headed feathered shafts plated with gold near the feathers, and resembling venomous serpents.

sa: उपलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां राजा राक्षसपुङ्गवः॥ पुत्रशोकाकुलो दीनो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः।
en: Then regaining his consciousness after a long while, that foremost of Räkşasas-the kingover-whelmed with grief for his son, and distressed, burst into lamentations, with his senses wildered, thus.

sa: स तस्य दृष्ट्यर्पणसम्प्रचोदितः प्रतापवान् काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः। समुत्पपाताथ सदस्युदीरितो द्विजातिमुख्यैर्हविषेव पावकः॥
en: That puissant one of a bow decked with gold, on being commanded (by Rāvana) with a glance started up, like to fire on being fed by clarified butter by foremost regenerate persons on the sacrificial ground.

sa: तरुणादित्यसंकाशं विमानं रामवाहनम्। धनदस्य प्रसादेन दिव्यमेतन्मनोजवम्॥
en: This celestial car, resembling the newly risen Sun, coursing at will and carrying Rāma (was gained) by the favour of the Giver of wealth.

sa: ततो हर्षसमुद्भूतो निःस्वनो दिवमस्पृशत्। स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानां रामोऽयमिति कीर्तिते॥
en: Thereupon with the sound of there is Rama' there arose a joyous noise reaching the abode of the celestials from among women, children, the young and the old.

sa: सा नूनमसितापाङ्गी रक्षोमध्यगता सती। मन्नाथा नाथहीनेव त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: Alas that chaste dame having scarlet corners of the eye, being encircled by the demons, is wishing for a protector like to one having no husband, albeit having a husband in me.

sa: नरेन्द्राम्बुजपत्राक्ष पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन। अतुलं ते बलं येन दशग्रीवस्त्वया जितः॥
en: O foremost of kings, O you having eyes like lotus-petals! O you having a countenance like the full moon! When you have vanquished Ravaņa, your prowess is matchless in the triple world.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तो हनुमान्गत्वा चौषधिपर्वतम्।। चिन्तामभ्यमच्छीमानजानंस्ता महौषधीः॥
en: Having been thus in strutted, Hanuman, repairing to the medicinal mountain, was wrought up with anxiety not knowing the drugs.

sa: तस्याग्निदीप्तसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी। ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ॥
en: The large eyes of that one, resembling a life flame and endowed with the splendour of lighting, appeared like a pair of glowing planets.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा महातेजाः सौमित्रिमित्रनन्दनः। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र चित्रं विस्फारयन्धनुः॥
en: Thereupon saying, 'So be it,' the exceedingly energetic son of Sumitrā-that delight of his friends, took up his post there stretching his variegated bow.

sa: वृतोभिनिष्क्रम्य रणोत्सुको बली। ददर्श तां राघवबाहुपालितां महौघकल्पां बहु वानरी चमूम्॥
en: Then as that strong and fearful one, eager for encounter, surrounded by in numerable nigh rangers, issued out (of the city), he beheld that monkey-host, protected by the arm of Rāghava, resembling the deep at the time of universal dissolution.

sa: विदितः सर्वधर्मज्ञः शरणागतवत्सलः। तेन मैत्री भवतु ते यदि जीवितुमिच्छसि॥
en: It is known to the world, that Rāma know well the sanctions of religion and is kind to them who seek his shelter. Do you seek his friendship, if do you wish to maintain your life.

sa: स तलाभिहतस्तेन स्रस्तहस्ताम्बरो भुवि। निपपात महातेजास्त्रिशिरास्त्यक्तचेतनः।॥
en: And smitten with that slap, the highly powerful Triśiras, with his hands and attire dropping off, fell down to the earth, deprived of consciousness.

sa: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टो राक्षसांस्तानुपस्थितान्। द्रष्टुमेनमिहेच्छामि यथान्यायं च पूज्यताम्॥
en: Thereat, Ravana, pleased, spoke to those Raks asas who had presented themselves, “I wish to see him here, and do you honour him fittingly."

sa: प्रियाप्रिये सुखे दुःखे लाभालाभे हिताहिते। धर्मकामार्थकृच्छेषु यूयमर्हथ वेदितुम्॥
en: When virtue, or happiness, or interest is in straits, it behove you to (know your course) in relation to pleasant and unpleasant, happiness and misery, profitable and unprofitable, and good and evil.

sa: धर्षणामर्षितो रामो धैर्य रोषेण लम्भयन्। जग्राह सुमहावेगमैन्द्रं युधि शरासनम्॥ शरांश्च सुमहावेगान्सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान्। तदुपोढं महद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्गिणोः।। परस्पराभिमुखयोर्दृप्तयोरिव सिंहयोः॥
en: Enraged at the smiting. Rāma, with his ire aroused, but summoning up patience, took up in the encounter the bow of Indra endowed with exceeding vehemence; well as highly impetuous shafts having the resplendence of the solar rays. And then there began a furious encounter between those (two) eager for slaying each other confronting each other like to flaming lions.

sa: अङ्गदो नाम लक्ष्मीवान् वालिसूनुर्महाबलः। प्रस्थितः कपिशार्दूलस्त्रिभागबलसंवृतः॥
en: Own I am one of them And the beautiful and mighty son of Vali, by name Angada, has proceeded with three armies under him.

sa: तामापतन्ती संप्रेक्ष्य सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। चिच्छेद निशितैर्बाणैर्दशधापातयद्भुवि ॥
en: Seeing it descend, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy severed the same with whetted arrows and brought it down in ten fragments to the ground.

sa: दिष्ट्याहं हरिसैन्यानां त्वन्नाशमनुशोचताम्॥ अपनेष्यामि संतापं तवाधिगमशासनात्।
en: By my good luck I shall be able, with your news, to remove the grief of those monkey hosts who are lamenting for you.

sa: तं प्रासमालोक्य तदा विभग्नं सुपर्णकृत्तोरगवीर्यकल्पम्। स्तुरंगमस्याभिजघान मूर्धि॥
en: Seeing the praśa broken in pieces, like a powerful snake severed by Suparna, Vāli's son, raising his hand, dealt a slap at the head of his (Narāntaka's) steed.

sa: ततो विभुश्चतुर्वक्रो विमानवरमाश्रितः। सुकेशपुत्रानामन्त्र्य वरदोऽस्मीत्यभाषत॥
en: Then that lord-the four-faced one-stationed on a superb car, addressed Sukeśa's sons, saying, “I am for conferring boons (on you).'

sa: दृष्ट्वोवाच महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः। कुमारमङ्गदं वीरं शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: As soon as he saw (that hero), the exceedingly energetic lord of monkeys, Sugriva addressed the heroic prince Angada endowed with strength equal to that of Indra, saying.

sa: असूतास्ते हयास्तत्र रथमूहुरविक्लवाः॥ मण्डलान्यभिधावन्ति तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: And deprived of their driver, there the steeds, retaining their calmness, began to go in rounds and this was wonderful.

sa: तानप्राप्ताशितैर्भाणैश्चिच्छेद परवीरहा। सारथेरस्य च रणे रथिनो रथसत्तमः॥ शिरो जहार धर्मात्मा भल्लेनानतपर्वणा।
en: And ere they reached their destination, that slayer of hostile heroes severed them with whetted arrows; and in the encounter that righteous one and foremost of car-warriors with a dart having bent joints, cut off the head of his charioteer mounted on the car.

sa: तस्याग्रे मुसलस्याग्निरशोकापीडसंनिभः। प्रहस्तकरमुक्तस्य बभूव प्रदहनिव॥
en: And the top of the mace freed from the hand of Prahasta, was ablaze like the tips of Asoka flowers.

sa: योऽन्यस्त्वेवंविधं ब्रूयाद्वाक्यमेतन्निशाचर। अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते न भवेत्त्वां तु धिक्कुलपांसन॥
en: Fie you, O night ranger, O you that bring disgrace on the family. Had any one else spoken thus he would have ceased to live by this time.

sa: स सुहृद्यो विपन्नाथ दीनमभ्युपपद्यते। स बन्धुर्योऽपनीतेषु साहाय्यायोपकल्पते॥
en: He is a friend that succour one fallen in distress and is undergoing affliction; and he acts friendly that helped a person lapsing from the path of morality.

sa: ततस्तद्धनुमान् वीरो बभञ्ज प्रमदावनम्। मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टं नानादुमलतायुतम्॥
en: Then that hero, Hanumān, devastated that garden of the damsels, resounding with the roars of mad elephants, and filled with diverse trees and shrubs.

sa: द्रुमांश्च विपुलस्कन्धान्गृह्य वानरपुङ्गवाः। तद्युद्धमभवद्घोरं रक्षोवानरसंकुलम्॥ ते पादपशिलाशैलैश्चक्रुर्वृष्टिमनूपमाम्। बाणौधैर्यमाणाश्च हरयो भीमविक्रमाः।॥
en: The encounter that took place between the thronging Räkşasa and monkeys was some-thing terrific. And (the monkeys) began to pour a wonderful shower of trees and rocks and cliffs. The monkeys of dread prowess were resisted with vollies of shafts.

sa: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्मथितसारथिः। शरवर्षेण सौमित्रिमभ्यधावत रावणिः॥
en: Springing down from his car whose steeds had been slain, Ravana's son, his charioteer having been pounded, charged the son of Sumitra with arrows.

sa: अल्पशेषमिदं कार्यं दृष्टेयमसितेक्षणा। त्रीनुपायानतिक्रम्य चतुर्थ इह दृश्यते॥
en: A small work it is that remains. Beheld have I this dark-eyed lady. Passing by three means, I see that I shali have to resort to the fourth.

sa: योऽसौ चक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जनार्दनः। हरिनारायणः श्रीमाशरणं तं प्रपद्यथ॥
en: Do you seek the shelter of him who hold the discus and mace in his hands, and who is clad in a yellow attire, of Janardana, Hari, even of the auspicious Nārāyaṇa.

sa: अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगुणोत्तम। क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम्॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, present this sign to Rāma, and tell him also for a sign that he had in ire hurled the dart which destroyed a single eye of the crow.

sa: कुसुमिततरुजालसंततानि भ्रमरयुतानि समुद्रतीरजानि। कनकविमलहारभूषिताङ्गी विहर मया सह भीरु काननानि॥
en: And adorned with beautiful golden necklace, O timid lady, do you at your pleasure, range with me, in the forests, situated on the bank of the ocean, and filled with flowery trees and black bees. a

sa: अतीतदिवसे वृत्तं प्रशंसन्ति न वा पुनः। गुप्तैश्चारैरनुमतैः पृथिवीमनुसारयेत्॥
en: The king should make secret and trusted agents travel through the kingdom for ascertaining whether his conduct of the previous day has, or has not, met with the approbation of the subjects.

sa: नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय गोब्राह्मणहिताय च। जगद्धिताय कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय नमो नमः॥
en: Salutations to you, O God, that are the Brahmana's self, to you who are the benefactor of Brahmanas and kine, to you that are the benefactor of the universe, to you that are Krishna and Govinda.

sa: ऋचीक उवाच नोक्तपूर्वानृतं भद्रे स्वैरेष्वपि कदाचन। किमुताग्निं समाधाय मन्त्रवच्चरुसाधने॥
en: Richika said 'I had never uttered even in jest, O blessed lady, an untruth. What need then be said of a time for preparing sanctified food with the help of Vedic formulae after lighting a fire?

sa: तथानुकम्पमानेन यज्वनाथामितौजसा॥ पराशरेण दायादः सौदासस्याभिरक्षितः।
en: Another, viz., the son of Saudasa, has been protected, through pity, by the highly energetic Parashara ever engaged in sacrifices.

sa: ततस्ते ददृशुर्भीष्मं शरप्रस्तरशायिनम्। स्वरश्मिजालसंवीतं सायंसूर्यसमप्रभम्॥
en: They then saw Bhishma lying on his arrowy bed and shining like the evening Sun covered with his own rays.

sa: जटिने दण्डिने नित्यं लम्बोदरशरीरिणे। कमण्डलुनिषङ्गाय तस्मै ब्रह्मात्मने नमः॥
en: You had assumed the form of a hermit with matted locks on head, staff in hand, a long stomach, and having alms bowl for your quiver. Salutations to your form of Brahma.

sa: कथयेद् देवलोकं यो देवराजसमीपतः। धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणां सोऽर्थं ब्रूयात् तवाग्रतः॥
en: That person, who can speak on the subject of heaven before the king of the celestials, himself is able to deal with morality and desire and profit and liberation in your presence.

sa: यदृच्छया निपतितं चक्रमादित्यगोचरम्। महावातसमुत्थेन संशुष्कमिव सागरम्॥ पूर्णचन्द्रमिव व्योम्नि तुषारावृतमण्डलम्। रेणु ध्वस्तं दीर्घभुजं मातङ्गमिव विक्रमे॥
en: Indeed, they saw him lying on the ground like the Sun dropped on the Earth or like the Occan dried by a mighty wind, or like the Full Moon in the sky with his disc covered with fog. Like an elephant in prowess and possessing long arms, the king lay on the Earth, covered with dust.

sa: लोहितोदां केशतृणां गजशैलां ध्वजगुमाम्। महीं करोति युद्धेषु क्षत्रियो यः स धर्मवित्॥
en: That Kshatriya knows his duty who in battle converts the Earth into a lake of blood, having the hairs of killed warriors for the grass and straw floating on it, and having elephants for its rocks, and standards for the trees on its banks.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु भगवांस्तनुर्मुनिवरोत्तमः। अवाक्शिरा ध्यानपरो मुहूर्तमिव तस्थिवान्।१८।।
en: Hearing these words of the king, that foremost of ascetics, viz., the holy Tanu, remained for a short while with head lowering down and himself immersed in contemplation.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच अस्त्रैर्बहुविधैर्दग्धः पूर्वमेवायमर्जुन। मदधिष्ठित्तत्वात् समरे न विशीर्णः परंतप॥
en: Vasudeva said That car, O Arjuna, had already been consumed by various sorts of weapons. It was because I had sat upon it during battle that it did not break into pieces, O destroyer of foes.

sa: किमेतन्महदाश्चर्यमभवद् यदुनन्दन। तन्मे ब्रूहि महाबाहो श्रोतव्यं यदि मन्यसे॥
en: Whiat is this highly wonderful incident that has taken place before our eyes? O you of mighty arms, if you think that I can hear it without injury then tell me everything.'

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in respect of the four principle attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son.

sa: अभावादीनि भूतानि भावमध्यानि भारत। अभावनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: In the beginning creatures are non-existent. In the middle, O Bharata, they become existent. At the end, they once more become non-existent. What is there to be sorry for in all this.

sa: अथातवतीर्णे भूतानामीश्वरे सुमहात्मनि। कपिरन्तर्दधे दिव्यो ध्वजो गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥
en: After the great Lord of all creatures had got down from that car, the celestials Ape that was on the standard of Arjuna's car disappeared there and then.

sa: आत्मनाऽऽत्मानमाश्वास्य मा शुचः पुरुषर्षभ। नाद्य शोकाभिभूतस्त्वं कार्यमुत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि।॥
en: Do you comfort your oneself. Do not grieve, O foremost of men. You should not allow yourself to be overwhelmed with so row and give up all work.

sa: गान्धारी पुत्रशोकार्ता भर्तुर्वचननोदिता। सह कुन्त्या यतो राजा सह स्त्रीभिरुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Then Gandhari, stricken stricken with grief consequent the death of his sons, accompanied by Kunti and the other ladies of the royal household, came, as ordered by her lord, where the latter was waiting for her.

sa: आसन् वर्षसहस्त्रिण्यस्तथा वर्षसहस्रकाः। अरोगा: सर्वसिद्धार्था रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: Every man lived for a thousand years, and every man was fortunate enough to have a thousand children. During Rama's reign, all men enjoyed health and obtained the fruition of their wishes.

sa: यैर्यैरुपायैर्लोकस्तु न चलेदार्यवर्त्मनः। तत् सर्वं राजशार्दूल नीतिशाकेऽभिवर्णितम्॥
en: All those means, O foremost of kings, by which men might be prevented from falling off from the path of righteousness and honesty were all treated in it.

sa: स भिन्नमर्मा रुधिरं वमन् वित्रस्तमानसः॥ पपाताभिमुखो दीनो मद्रराजस्त्वपाक्रमत्।
en: Cut to the quick, the driver, vomiting blood, fell down with a trembling heart. At this the king of the Madras got down from his car and looked at Bhiina in depression.

sa: मण्डलावर्तमार्गेषु गदाविहरणेषु च। निर्विशेषमभूद् युद्धं तयोः पुरुषिसंहयोः॥
en: In that encounter between those two best of men, no difference was perceptible between them either in their movement or in the manner of their holding the mace.

sa: शत्रुसाधारणे कृत्ये कृत्वा संधि बलीयसा॥ समाहितश्चरेद् युक्त्या कृतार्थश्च न विश्वसेत्।
en: Having made an agreement with a stronger one, when both are threatened by enemies, a weak person should act carefully after considerations of policy. Having gained his object, the weaker of the two parties should not again trust the stronger.

sa: शुभं हि कर्म राजेन्द्र शुभत्वायोपकल्पते। आत्मना कारणैश्चैव समस्येह महीक्षितः॥
en: All good acts, O king, lead to the wellbeing of a monarch. The conduct of a king should be governed by his own intelligence as also by the opportunities and means that may come of themselves.

sa: उन्मत्तमिव मातङ्गं तलशब्दैर्नराधिपाः। भूयः संहर्षयाचक्रुर्दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥
en: The kings present once again cheered your wrathful son with claps like persons exciting a mad elephant to a fight.

sa: उवाच च महाबाहुः पुनः पुनररिंदमः। वासुदेवार्जुनो प्रेम्णा तावुभौ परिषस्वजे॥
en: Having got up from his seat that repressor of his enemies, the king of mighty arms, again and again locked Arjuna and Krishna in his loving embraces. Then he asked Krishna about particulars (of Karna's death).

sa: अन्योन्यकृतवैरी तु चक्रतुः प्रीतिमुत्तमाम्॥ अन्योन्यमभिसंधातुं सम्बभूव तयोर्मतिः।
en: When two persons who were once enemy 1.1ake peace with each other, it is certain that each of them has it in his heart to control the other.

sa: वधं कर्णस्य संग्रामे दीर्घकालचिकीर्षितम्। निवेद्य धर्मराजाय त्वमानृण्यं गमिष्यसि॥
en: Having given an account of the death of Karna, for which you had been trying for many years, to the virtuous king Yudhishthira, you will be freed from your debt to him.

sa: एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाराज शास्त्रार्थमभिगम्य च।२०८॥ अभियुक्तोऽप्रमत्तश्च प्राग्भयाद् भीतवच्चरेत्।
en: knowing this, O king, and remembering the truths of scripture, one should, ser:sibly and carefully, act like a person in fear before the cause of fear actually arrives.

sa: ऋषयस्तं प्रशंसन्ति साधु चैतदसंशयम्। सर्वथा सर्वदा वर्णैर्यष्टव्यमिति निर्णयः॥
en: The Rishis speak highly of such a man. Forsooth they are right. This then is the conclusion that all the castes should always and by every means in their power celebrate sacrifices.

sa: भीतवत् संनिधिः कार्यः प्रतिसंधिस्तथैव च॥ भयादुत्पद्यते बुद्धिरप्रमत्ताभियोगजा।
en: One should before the cause of fear actually arrived, act like a person in fear, and make peace with enenies. Such fear and carefulness beget keenness of understanding.

sa: अभीश्चरति यो नित्यं मन्त्रोऽदेयः कथंचन॥ अविज्ञानाद्धि विज्ञातो गच्छेदास्पददर्शिषु।
en: Never cherish fear,-such an advice should never be given to any one. The person, who entertains fear from a consciousness of his weakness, always seuks the advice of wise and experienced men.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मरताः शूरा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः। प्राप्ता वीरगतिं पुण्यां तान् न शोचितुमर्हसि॥ मृतान् महानुभावांस्त्वं श्रुत्वैव पृथिवीपतीन्।
en: Always following the duties of Kshatriyas, endued with courage, well read in the Vedas and their branches, all of them have attained to that blissful region which is obtainable by heroes. You should not grieve for them after hearing those high-souled kings of Earth, of ancient days, that departed from this world.

sa: स्वदारतष्टस्त्वृतुकालगामी नियोगसेवी न शठो न जिह्मः। मिताशनो देवरतः कृतज्ञः सत्यो मृदुश्चानृशंसः क्षमावान्॥
en: He shouid be satisfied with his own married wife and should never approach her except in her season. He should follow prescription of the scriptures, should not be cunning and deceitful. He should be sparing in diet, devoted to the gods, grateful, mild, shorn of cruelty, and forgiving.

sa: सोऽहं वागाविद्यानां रसानामवलेहिता। स्वजात्यानधितिष्ठामि नक्षत्राणीव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: I taste the ambrosia dropped by those learned men, and like the Moon among the stars I live among the members of my family.

sa: दान्तो विधेयो हव्यकव्येऽप्रमत्तौ ह्यन्नस्य दाता सततं द्विजेभ्यः। अमत्सरी सर्वलिङ्गप्रदाता वैताननित्यश्च गृहाश्रमी स्यात्॥
en: He should be of a tranquil heart, peaceful and careful in making offerings to the gods and the Pitris. He should always be hospitable to the Brahmanas. He should be shorn of pride and should not make charity to one sect. He should always carefully perforinthe Vedic rites.

sa: अविरुद्धां त्रिवर्गेण नीतिमेतां महीपते॥ अभ्युत्तिष्ठ श्रुतादस्माद् भूयः संरक्षयन् प्रजाः।
en: This path of policy is quite of a piece with the three-fold objects of life, (viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure) O king! Guided by this Shruti, do you acquire prosperity by once more protecting your subjects.

sa: सोऽयं विपुलमध्वानं कालेन ध्रुवमध्रुवः। नरोऽवशः समभ्येति सर्वभूतनिषेवितम्॥
en: Man, whose existence is so transitory is compelled, in course of Time, whether he will or no, to come upon this inevitable and broad path of all creatures.

sa: अनित्ये प्रियसंवासे संसारे चक्रवद्गतौ। पथि सङ्गतमेवैतद् भ्राता माता पिता सखा॥
en: Life and its surroundings are always revolving like a wheel, and the companionship of those who are dear in only for the time being. The union with brother, mother, father, and friend is like that of travellers in an inn.

sa: क्षत्रधर्माच्च्युतो राज्ञि भवेयं शाश्वतीः समाः। प्रतिज्ञां तामनिस्तीर्य ततस्तत् कृतवानहम्॥
en: I would for all years to come, have been regarded to have neglected the duties of a Kshatriya if I had left that promise unfulfilled. It was for this, O queen, that I did that act.

sa: सात्यकिश्च शतेनैनं धर्मपुत्रपरीप्सया। मद्रेश्वरमवाकीर्य सिंहनादमथानदत्॥
en: Satyaki, desirous of rescuing the son of Dharma, strucks Shalya with a hundred arrows and uttered a loud leonine roar.

sa: षष्टिर्मुनिसहस्राणि शिष्यत्वं प्रतिपेदिरे॥ सारस्वतस्य विप्रर्वेदस्वाध्यायकारणात्।
en: Sixty thousand ascetics became disciples of the great Rishi Sarasvat for the sake of learning again the Vedas from him.

sa: अथ कश्चिदृषिस्तेषां सारस्वतमुपेयिवान्॥ कुर्वाणं संशितात्मानं स्वाध्यायमृषिसत्तमम्।
en: It so happened that some one amongst them met Sarasvat, that foremost of Rishis, while the latter was reading the Vedas with concentrated attention.

sa: वरदानेन कृष्णस्य महर्षेः पुण्यकर्मणः। दिव्यज्ञानबलोपेता विविधं पर्यदेवयत्॥
en: By virtue of the gift of the boon by the great Rishi Vyasa of pure deeds, she came by spiritual knowledge and power. The lady then piteously bewailed.

sa: ततो मुनिवरं भूयो जैगीषव्यमथासितः॥ नान्वपश्यत लोकस्थमन्तर्हितमरिंदम।
en: At this point, O chastiser of foes, Asita lost sight of Jaigishavya that foremost of ascetics, who, rapt in Yoga, disappeared from his view.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वं पश्यन्त्यो दुःखार्ता भरतस्त्रियः। शरीरेष्वस्खलनन्याः पतन्त्यश्चापरा भुवि॥
en: Witnessing sights the like of which they had never before seen, the Bharata ladies felt their limbs to be deprived of strength and dropped down on the ground.

sa: शोभितं पुरुषव्याप्रैः कर्णभीष्माभिमन्युभिः। द्रोणद्रुपदशल्यैश्च ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः॥
en: See the field of battle is adorned with those foremost of men, viz., Bhishma and Karna and Abhimanyu and Drona and Drupada and Shalya.

sa: नदीमार्गेषु च तथा संक्रमानवसादयेत्। जलं विस्त्रावयेत् सर्वमविस्त्राव्यं च दूषयेत्॥
en: He should destroying all the bridges over the rivers in his kingdom. He should draw out the waters of all the tanks in his territories, or, if incapable to do so, cause them to be poisoned.

sa: तप्तजाम्बूदनदनिभं ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभम्। जीवन्तमिव तं शूरं सर्वभूतानि मेनिरे॥
en: Every one saw that the body of the heroes resembled burning gold. It appeared to have been instinct with life and looked effulgent like the sun or fire.

sa: अस्तब्धः पूजयेन्मान्यान् गुरून् सेवेदमायया। अर्चेद् देवानदम्भेन श्रियमिच्छेदकुत्सिताम्॥
en: He should without pride pay respect to worthy persons, and serve his preceptors and seniors with sincerity. He should seek prosperity, but never do anything that brings calumny.

sa: धनानि तेभ्यो दद्यास्त्वं यथाशक्ति यथार्हतः। सान्त्वयन् परिरक्षश्च स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि दुर्जयम्॥
en: You should give them wealth to the best of your power and according to their worthiness, and protect them, comforting them at all times. By acting thus you may acquire regions which are acquired with difficulty.

sa: यदह्ना कुरुते पापमरक्षन् भयतः प्रजाः। राजा वर्षसहस्रेण तस्यान्तमधिगच्छति॥
en: The sin, a king incurs by neglecting for a single day to protect his subjects from fear, is such that his sufferings are not terminated in hell till after a thousand years.

sa: वसिष्ठमीशं विप्राणां वसूनां जातवेदसम्। तेजसा भास्करं चक्रे नक्षत्राणां निशाकरम्॥
en: Vashishtha was made the king of the Brahmanas, and Jatavedas was made the chief of the Vasus. Surya was made the lord of all luminous bodies and Chandramas was made the lord of Stars and constellations,

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। ऐलकश्यपसंवादं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story about the discourse between Aila's son and Kashyapa. Listen to it, О Yudhishthira.

sa: द्विजावमानादन्यत्र प्रादाद् वरमनुत्तमम्। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददौ तस्मै जगत्पतिः॥
en: The Lord of the universe granted that high boon of freedom from fear of all creatures, subject to the only condition that he should be careful of how he offended the Brahmanas.

sa: ज्वालाकेशाश्च राजेन्द्र ज्वलद्रोमचतुर्भुजाः। मेषवक्त्रास्तथैवान्ये तथा छागमुखा नृप॥
en: The hair on the heads and bodies of some were burning, and some had four arms, and some, O king, had faces like those of sheep and goats.

sa: याम्या रौद्रास्तथा सौम्याः कौवेर्योऽथ महाबलाः॥३६ वारुण्योऽथ च माहेन्द्रयऽस्तथाऽऽग्नेय्यः परंतप।
en: Possessed of great strength, some amongst them partook of the nature of Yama, soine of Rudra, some of Soma, some of Kuvera, some of Varuna, some of Indra and some of Agni, O destroyer of foes.

sa: दीर्घनख्यो दीर्घदन्त्यो दीर्घतुण्ड्यश्च भारत॥ सबला मधुराश्चैव यौवनस्थाः स्वलंकृता।
en: There nails were long, their teeth were large and their lips also, O Bharata, were projecting. Of straight forms and handsome features, all of them, endowed with youth, were adorned with ornaments.

sa: न बुद्ध्यसे त्वं दुर्बुद्धे भीमसेनममर्षणम्। वाड्नाराचैस्तुदंस्तीक्ष्णैरुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: O fool, do you not think of Bhimasena filled with anger. You are cutting him with your words arrows like a person striking an elephant with burning brands.

sa: स राजा धर्मविन्नित्यं सह पत्न्या महातपाः। मुञ्जपृष्ठं जगामाथ पितृदेवर्षिपूजितम्॥
en: That king was always engaged in acts of piety, and accompanied by his wife he always practised the austerest penances. He went to the spot called Munjaprishtha highly respected by the Pitris and the celestial Rishis.

sa: भर्तृप्रत्यय उत्पन्नो व्यवहारस्तथापरः। तस्माद् यः स हितो दृष्टो भर्तुप्रत्ययलक्षणः॥
en: There is another kind of Vyavahara (Law) originating from the disputes of litigants which also has sprung from Brahman. Principally marked by a belief in either of the two parties, that Vyavahara, (Law) yields great good.

sa: सर्वमङ्गलसम्भारैर्विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्। आभिषेचनिक द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा देवातगणाः॥
en: The gods collected there all sorts of sacred articles, with due rites and mantras, that were necessary for the ceremony.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा कुरुराजस्य शूरार्यसदृशं वचः। सूतो हेमपरिच्छन्नाशनैरश्वानचोदयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the Kuru Chief becoming a hero and an honorable man the driver slowly drove his horses adorned with golden trappings.

sa: एतेभ्यो बलिमादद्याद्धीनकोशो महीपतिः। ऋते ब्रह्मसमेभ्यश्च देवकल्पेभ्य एव च॥
en: If the king's treasury is not well replenished, he may take tribute from these. In realising tribute, the king, however, should except those Brahmanas who are equal to the gods or Brahma.

sa: विकर्मस्थाश्च नोपेक्ष्या विप्रा राज्ञा कथंचन। नियम्याः संविभज्याश्च धर्मानुग्रहकारणात्॥
en: The king should never treat in-differently those Brahmanas who do not observe their duties. For the sake of making his people virtuous, he should punish and take them away from their betters.

sa: तथैतमन्वनृत्यन्तः देवकन्या सहस्रशः। दिव्यवादित्रनृत्यज्ञाः स्तुवन्त्यश्चारुदर्शनाः॥
en: Thousands of celestial girls, of very handsome features, accomplished in celestial music and dance, lauded him and danced before him.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच आवन्त्यं भीमसेनेन भक्षयन्ति निपातितम्। गृघ्रगोमायवः शूरं बहुबन्धुमबन्धुवत्॥
en: Gandhari said "See, killed by Bhimasena, the king of Avanti lies there. Vultures and jackals and crows are feasting upon that hero. Through possessed of many friends, he lies now perfectly helpless.

sa: युद्ध्यमानस्य तस्याहं चिन्तयानश्च भारत। योद्धारं नाधिगच्छामि तुल्यरूपं जनाधिप॥
en: O Bharata! O King of kings! My mind in course of searching in depth for the cominander of army, is not able to see any other warrior capable as Shalya in war-craft.

sa: अनुस्मृत्य तु शास्त्राणि कवयः समवस्थिताः। अपीह स्यादपीह स्यात् सारासारदिदृक्षया॥
en: Those that are learned live, meditating on the scriptures for finding out what is unreal. They, however, jump at this and that in the belief that the object of their search exists in this and that.

sa: अभूतिकामा भूतानां तादृशैर्मेऽभिसंहितम्॥ यो वा भवद्विनाशेन राज्यमिच्छत्यनन्तरम्।
en: Making a conspiration with those servants who can always approach you, they covet the kingdom after destroying you. Their plans, however, have not succeeded owing to unforeseen circumstances.

sa: अपरे नैवमिच्छन्ति ये शङ्खलिखितप्रियाः। मात्सर्यादथवा लोभान ब्रूयुर्वाक्यमीदृशम्॥
en: They, however, who laud the conduct followed by Shankha towards Likhita, do not hold this opinion. They do not pass such an opinion through either malice or covetousness.

sa: स्कन्धवान् मेघसङ्काशः शीतच्छायो मनोरमः। अरण्यमभितो जातः स तु व्यालमृगाकुलः॥
en: It had a large trunk from which numerous branches spread on all sides. Delightful to look at, its shade was very refreshing. It stood in the midst of the forest, and various animals lived on it.

sa: ततस्तालकेतुर्महाधर्मकेतुर्महात्मा कृतात्मा महादाननित्यः। वसिष्ठापवाहं महाभीमवेगं धृतात्मा जितात्मा समभ्याजगाम॥
en: The illustrious and righteous Baladeva, of cleansed soul, having the palmyra on his banner and ever giving away the most valuable things, then proceeded to that tirtha of fierce current called Vashishthapavaha.

sa: अभिन्नवृत्ता विद्वांसः सद्वृत्ताश्चरितव्रताः। न त्वां नित्यार्थिनो जझुरक्षुद्राः सत्यवादिनः॥
en: They who are unchangeable in conduct, endued with learning and good behaviour, observant of excellent vows, large-hearted, and truthful in speech, will always attend to your affairs and will never forsake you.

sa: स राजन् मोक्ष्यसे पापात् तेन पूर्णेन हेतुना। प्राणार्थं वा धनेनैषामथवा नृपकर्मणा॥
en: Therefore, for the reasons already pointed out by me, you, O king, shall be freed off of all your sins, for you have slain your enemies in the discharge of your duties as a king and for the protection of your life and inheritance,

sa: अदत्तस्यानुपादानं दानमध्ययनं तपः। अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोध इज्या धर्मस्य लक्षणम्॥
en: Refusal to take what is not given, gift, study of sacred books, penance, abstention from injury, truth, freedom from anger, and adoration of the gods in sacrifices,-these are the marks of virtue.

sa: विप्रहीणरथाश्वांस्तानवधीत् पुरुषर्षभः॥ एकविंशतिसाहस्रान् पदातीन् समपोथयत्।
en: The mighty Bhiina, with his mace, crushed those twenty one thousand foot-soldiers who deprived of cars and horses and elephants.

sa: सिंहस्त्वं बलमापन्नो भूयः शरभतां गतः॥ मया स्नेहपरीतेन विसृष्टो न कुलान्वयः।
en: From a powerful lion, you were then transformed into a Sharabha. Filled with love for you, it was I who transformed you into these various forms You did not, and do not belong by birth, to any of those species.

sa: सान्त्वनं रक्षणं दानमवस्था चाप्यभीक्ष्णशः। गोमिनां पार्थ कर्तव्यः संविभागः प्रियाणि च॥
en: The king, O son of Pritha, should always conciliate and protect the Vaishyas, take measures for filling them with a sense of security and for ensuring them in the enjoyment of what they possess, and always do what they like.

sa: यं दिव्यैर्देवमर्चन्ति गुरैः परमनामभिः॥ यस्मिन् नित्यं तपस्तप्तं यदङ्गेष्वनुतिष्ठति।
en: Penances are always present in you, penances, live in your form. You are the Universal Soul. You are omniscient. You are the universe. You are the creator of everything in the universe.

sa: विदितास्त्रस्ततः कर्णो रममाणोऽऽश्रमे भृगोः। चकार वै धनुर्वेदे यत्नमद्भुतविक्रमः॥
en: Having acquired a knowledge of that weapon, Karna began to live happily in Bhrigu's retreat, and highly powerful as he was, he devoted himself with great energy to the science of arms.

sa: स्थानान्येतानि संयम्य प्रसंगो भूतिनाशनः। कामे प्रसक्तः पुरुषः किमकार्यं विवर्जयेत्॥
en: The following sins of which I speak should be checked. they are such as bring on penury on every one. What wicked act is there that a person under the influence of passion would not commit.

sa: कणस्तु वेदनां धैर्यादसह्यां विनिगृह्य ताम्। अकम्पयन्नव्यथयन् धारयामास भार्गवम्॥
en: Though the pain was unbearable, Karna endured it with heroic patience, and continued to hold Bhrigu's son on his lap, without trembling in the least and without displaying any sign of pain.

sa: रथैरश्ववरैर्युक्तैः किङ्किणीजालसंवृतः। आजग्मुरथ रक्षन्तः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, they came there on their cars possessed of great speed and adorned with rows of bells.

sa: सुरारिनिलयः शश्वत्सागरः सरिताम्पतिः। पप्रच्छ सरितः सर्वाः संशयं जातमात्मनः॥
en: In days of yore, eternal Ocean that lord of Rivers, that refuge of the enemies of the gods, asked all the Rivers for solving this doubt that had arisen in his mind.

sa: ऋषयो नियमांस्त्यक्त्वा परित्यज्याग्निदेवताः। आश्रमान् सम्परित्यज्य पर्यधावन्नितस्ततः॥
en: The very Rishis, giving up their vows and their fires and deities, and deserting their forest-retreats, began to walk about in quest of food.

sa: न तु वध्यधनं तिष्ठेत् पिबेयुर्ब्राह्मणाः पयः। युजीरन्नप्यनडुहः क्षन्तव्यं वा तदा भवेत्॥ राज्ञा राजैव योद्धव्यस्तथा धर्मो विधीयते। नान्यो राजानमभ्यस्येदराजन्यः कथञ्चन॥
en: The king should never appropriate the riches confiscated from thieves and others awaiting execution. The kine captured from the enemy by force should be given away to the Brahmanas so that they may drink their milk. The bulls taken from the enemy should be engaged in agricultural work or returned to the enemy. It is laid down that a king should fight with a king. One who is not a king should never strike a king.

sa: अश्वैश्च व्यपकृष्यन्त बहवोऽत्र गतासवः॥ रक्तोक्षितैश्छिन्नभूजैरवकृष्टशिरोरुहैः।
en: Many men, elated with the pride of courage and inspired with the desire of victory, dropped down on the earth.

sa: अपविध्यन्ति पापानि दानयज्ञतपोबलैः। अनुग्रहाय भूतानां पुण्यमेषां विवर्धते॥
en: By the power of gifts, sacrifices, and penances, they dissipate their sins, and their merit increases so that they may be able to do good to all creatures.

sa: पृष्ठतो भीरवः संख्ये वर्तन्तेऽधर्मपूरुषाः। शूराच्छरणमिच्छन्तः पर्जन्यादिव जीवनम्॥
en: Righteous persons, stricken with fear, stay in the rear, begging for life from heroes that have rushed to battle, even as men pray for rain from the clouds.

sa: पौरजानपदैर्दुःखाद्धाहेति भृशनादितम्॥ निरानन्दं गतश्रीकं हृताराममिवाशयम्।
en: Took leave of Yuyutsu and entered the palace of the king which was filled with the lamentations of woe-stricken citizens.

sa: ततस्त्रिभिस्तं त्रिदशाधिपोपमं शरैर्बिभेदाधिरर्थिर्धनंजयम्। शरांश्च पञ्च ज्वलितानिवोरगान् प्रवेशयामास जिघांसयाच्युतम्॥
en: Then the of Adhiratha struck Dhananjaya, who was looking like the king of Heaven (Indra) with three arrows and shot five other burning shafts like snakes for the purpose of killing Krishna.

sa: उपायधर्मान् वक्ष्यामि सिद्धार्थानर्थधर्मयोः। निर्मर्यादा दस्यवस्तु भवन्ति परिपन्थिनः॥
en: I shall presently describe to you the means and contrivances, which yield immediate fruit. Robbers, transgressing all wholesome limits, very often become destroyers of property and religious merit.

sa: तानभ्यापततः शीघ्रं हतशेषान् महारणे। शरैराशीविषाकारैः पाण्डवाः समवाकिरन्॥
en: The Pandavas, however, enshrouded with their arrows resembling venomous snakes, all the remnant of the Kaurava army, that thus rushed quickly against them in that dreadful battle. more

sa: स धनंजय निर्द्वन्द्वो मुनिर्ज्ञानसमन्वितः॥ वनमामन्त्र्य वः सर्वान् गमिष्यामि परंतप।
en: I shall, therefore, O Dhananjaya, go to the forest, with your permission, O scorcher of enemies, disregarding all the pairs of opposites, adopting the vow of silence, and walking in the way pointed out by knowledge.

sa: स सुप्त इव चाण्डालः श्लेष्मापिहितलोचनः। परिभिन्नस्वरो रूक्षः प्रोवाचाप्रियदर्शनः॥
en: The Chandala who was the owner of it, with eyes covered with pleghm, was lying like one asleep. Of disagreeable look, he said these harsh words in a broken and discordant voice.

sa: शीतवातातपसहः क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमक्षमः। तपसा विधिदृष्टेन शरीरमुपशोषयन्॥ मनःकर्णसुखा नित्यं शृण्वन्नुच्चावचा गिरः। मुदितानामरण्येषु वसतां मृगपक्षिणाम्॥
en: Enduring cold, wind, and heat, as also hunger and thirst and toil, I shall emaciate my body by penances as sanctioned by the scriptures. I shall daily listen to the clear notes of happy birds and animals living in the forest, which please the heart and the ear.

sa: तत्रैको दीर्घकालज्ञ उत्पन्नप्रतिभोऽपरः। दीर्घसूत्रश्च तत्रैकस्त्रयाणां सहचारिणाम्॥
en: Of those three, one had much fore-thought always liked to provide for the future. Another had great presence of mind. The third was idle.

sa: प्रहरिष्यन् ब्रूयात् प्रहरन्नापि भारत। प्रहत्य च कृपायीत शोचन्निव रुदनिवा॥
en: Before striking, O Bharata, and while sticking, utter sweet words; and while striking, utter sweet words; and after having beaten them, show them mercy and let them understand that you are grieving and weeping for them.

sa: इन्द्राशनिसमस्र्शानविषह्यान् महौजसः। विसृजन् दृश्यते बाणान् धारा मुञ्चनिवाम्बुदः॥
en: The arrows shot by Arjuna, irresistible and endued with great force and whose touch was like that of the thunder, resembled torrents of rain poured by a cloud.

sa: तस्यैव ह्रियमाणस्य स्त्रोतसेव तपोधन। फलमेतत् प्रपश्यामि यथालब्धेन वर्तयन्॥
en: The result, however, that I see, of my kingdom having been carried away by Time as by a stream, is that I am obliged to subsist upon whatever I get as alms.

sa: साध्वन्यमनुपश्य त्वमुपायं प्राणधारणे। न मांसलोभात् तपसो नाशस्ते स्यान्महामुने॥
en: Blessed to you, do you look out for some other means for keeping your life. O great sage, let not your penances suffer destruction for this your strong desire for dog's meat.

sa: कर्णिनालीकदंष्ट्रस्य खड्गजिह्वस्य संयुगे। चापव्यात्तस्य रौद्रस्य ज्यातलस्वननादिनः॥ क्रुद्धस्य नरसिंहस्य संग्रामेष्वपलायिनः। ये व्यमुञ्चन्त कर्णस्य प्रमादात् त इमे हताः॥
en: Alas, through carelessness have they been killed who had escaped from even Karna, that warrior who had barbed arrows and Nalikas for his teeth, the sword for his tongue, the bow for his mouth, and the twang of the bow, and the sound of palms for his roars-that angry Karna who never took to heels from battle, and : who was foremost of men.

sa: मन्त्रगुप्तिः प्रधानेषु चारश्चामित्रकर्षण। न गणाः कृत्स्नशो मन्त्रं श्रोतुमर्हन्ति भारत॥
en: Consultations should be held with the leaders of the aristocracy, and secret agents should be engaged, O crusher of foes, to watch them. The king should not, O Bharata, consult with every member of the aristocracy.

sa: नाकल्याणं न कल्याणं चिन्तयन्नुभयोस्तयोः। याः काश्चिज्जीवता शक्याः कर्तुमभ्युदयक्रियाः। सर्वास्ताः समभित्यज्य निमेषादिव्यवस्थितः॥
en: Abandoning all those acts which lead to prosperity and which one can do in life, the only acts I shall perform will be to open and shut my eyes and take as much food and drink as will barely keep up of my existence.

sa: अभावादीनि भूतानि भावमध्यानि भारत। अभावनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: As regards living creatures, they did not exist at first. They exist in the intervening period. In the end they once more become nonexistent. Why should then one grieve for the same?

sa: ततः शब्दः समभवत् समुद्रस्येव पर्वणि। हृष्टानां सम्प्रयातानां घोषो दिवमिवास्पृशत्॥
en: The sound proceeding from these was like the roar of the sea on the day of the new moon; and the shouts, sent by the cheerful soldiers proceeding along, touched the very heavens as it were.

sa: चिरदृष्टोऽयमस्माभिः प्रज्ञावान् बान्धवप्रियः। अतीव ज्वलितो लक्ष्म्या पाण्डुपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Partha salutes me and speaks to my ears. After a long time we have seen the wise son of Pandu, Dhananjaya, ever a favourite to his friends and greatly shining in prosperity.

sa: मातोवाच सर्वावस्था हि विदुषां तात धर्मार्थकारणात्। तावेवाभिसमीक्ष्याहं संजय त्वामचूचुदम्॥
en: The mother said All the doings, of those who are wise, are for the attainment of either virtue or worldly profit or both; and with my eye to these two along have urged you, O Sanjaya.

sa: यत्नाच्चोपचरेदेनमग्निवद् देववत् त्विह। अनृतेनोपचीर्णो हि हन्यादेव न संशयः॥
en: In this world a king should be carefully served like the fire-god or any other deity; one that plays false to the king is killed by him; this admits of no doubt.

sa: आनायितामनार्येण क्रोधलोभानुवर्तिना। सर्वे प्रेक्षन्त कुरव एकवस्त्रा सभागताम्॥
en: She dragged there by that dishonourable wretch, from motives of wrath and covetousness, and all the Kurus gazed on her brought to the Assembly-Hall in a single raiment.

sa: अल्पावशिष्टं कालस्य गतभूयिष्ठमन्ततः। तेषामज्ञातचर्यायामस्मिन् वर्षे त्रयोदशे॥
en: Of these thirteen years which they have to pass hidden from us all, the greater portion has well-high elapsed and only a little remains.

sa: पूर्वैः पूर्वतरैः प्रोक्तं परैः परतरैरपि। शाश्वतं चाव्ययं चैव प्रजापतिविनिर्मितम्॥
en: As described by our forefathers and by men before them, as also by men after them and after them again; it is highly praise worthy since it has been ordained by the lord of creatures himself.

sa: न स्मोपयान्ति निद्रां ते न तदर्हा जनार्दन। भेरीमृदङ्गनिनदैः शङ्खवैणवनिस्वनैः॥ स्त्रीणां गीतनिनादैश्च मधुरैर्मधुसूदन्। वन्दिमागधसूतैश्च स्तुवद्भिबौधिताः कथम्॥
en: It does not seem possible to me that they obtained sleep, though they did not at all deserve this, O Janardana, those who by the sound of cymbals and drums and the conches and flutes and by the sweet music of songs by woman, O slayer of Madhu, were awakened and praised by the prisoners and professional bards-how could they.

sa: ययातिरिव चोदारः सोमवत् प्रियदर्शनः। रूपेणान्यतमोऽश्विभ्यां धुमत्सेनसुतो बली॥
en: The heroic Satyavana is equal to Yayati in magnanimity, is as lovely to look at as the moon and is as beautiful as either of the twin Ashvinis.

sa: एतच्छस्त्रं नरेन्द्राणां महच्चक्रेण भासितम्। पुत्राः सलिलरजास्य धारयन्ति महोदयम्॥
en: This weapon, in its work among the kings, has been pronounced to be the great by Shakra and the son of the lord of the waters hold this weapon of great energy.

sa: सृज्यते ब्रह्ममूर्तिस्तु रक्षते पौरुषी तनुः। रौद्रीभावेन शमयेत् तिस्रोऽवस्थाः प्रजापतेः॥
en: There are three states of the supreme being; in the form of Brahma, he is the creator, in the form of Vishnu, he is the preserver and in the form of Rudra he is the destroyer.

sa: कोसलेन्द्रमथागम्य सर्वमावेद्य वानरः। विशश्राम स तेजस्वी राघवेणाभिनन्दितः॥
en: Then that monkey, approaching the lord of Kosala told him everything; and being highly praised by the descendant of Raghu, the energetic monkey went away to take rest.

sa: रुदत्यः सह गान्धार्या श्वगृध्रकुरराकुले। स यज्ञेऽस्मिन्नवभृथो भविष्यति जनार्दन।॥
en: Weeping loudly with Gandhari in the field of battle frequented by dogs and vultures and other carnivorous animals then will the final bath in connection with the sacrifice have taken place, OJanardana.

sa: नारद उवाच दृष्टस्ते वरुणः सूत पुत्रपौत्रसमावृतः। पश्योदकपते: स्थानं सर्वतोभद्रमृद्धिमत्॥
en: Narada said Varuna, surrounded by his sons and grandsons, has been seen by you o Suta. Behold now the territories of the lord of the waters which are excellent in every respect and full of riches.

sa: एतानि हृतराज्यानां दैतेयानां स्म मातले। दीप्यमानानि दृश्यन्ते सर्वप्रहरणान्युत॥
en: These weapons of all kinds, which are now visible and which are blazing, were once in the possession of the Daityas, whose territories have been wrested from them (by Varuna), O Matali.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि सर्परूपधरो महान्। विचरिष्यसि पूर्णेषु पुनः स्वर्गमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: For ten thousand years, assuming the form of a large snake, shall you roam about and at the completion of that period shall you again get into heaven.

sa: दुर्गाह्यः पाणिना वायुर्दुस्पर्शः पाणिनाशशी। दुर्धरा पृथिवी मूर्धा दुर्ग्राह्यः केशवोबलात्॥
en: Keshava is hard to capture by force even as air is incapable of being captured by living beings, as moon is incapable of being grasped by living beings and as the earth held on the head."

sa: द्विपञ्चशिरसः केचित् केचित् सप्तमुखास्तथा। महाभोगा महाकायाः पर्वताभोगभोगिनः॥
en: Some have twice five heads, some have seven faces and all of them are addicted to great pleasures and have huge bodies resembling the mountains of this earth.

sa: मतस्त्रैलोक्यराजस्य मातलि म सारथिः। तस्यैकैव कुले कन्या रूपतो लोकविश्रुता॥
en: Such is the story-The king of the three worlds had a driver by the name of Matali. In his family there was born only one daughter who had a great reputation for beauty in this world.

sa: तथेति ब्राह्मणेनोक्तं स राजा प्रीतमानसः। हंसचन्द्रांशुसंकाशं गृहमस्मै न्यवेदयत्॥
en: And that Brahmana having said “be it so," the king with a merry mind placed at his disposal a suite of apartments white as the swan or the ray of the moon.

sa: न बुद्धिर्धनलाभाय न जाड्यसमृद्धये। लोकपर्यायवृत्तान्तं प्राज्ञो जानाति नेतरः॥
en: Intelligence is not for the acquirement of wealth; and laziness is not the cause of adversity. The wise man knows the history of the different conditions of man; but others do not.

sa: तस्यास्य यत्नाच्चरतस्त्रैलोक्यममराते। सुमुखो भवत: पौत्रो रोचते दुहितुः पतिः॥
en: For her sake, he is searching carefully in the three worlds including the region of the gods, O illustrious one; and he selects Sumukha, your grandson, as the husband of his daughter.

sa: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयितः पुरा। त्वयाजयत् सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: Formerly you were the favourite charioteer of Arjuna and with you as his help that foremost of Pandavas conquered the earth; O good Brihannala, act (therefore) as the charioteer of my brother.

sa: समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं कालपक्कमसंशयम्। विमर्दश्च महान् भावी मांसशोणितकर्दमः॥
en: All these Kshatriyas, these rulers of the earth have their hour come and there will be a great massacre which will make the earth one mass of clay of flesh and blood.

sa: श्रीवत्सधारिणं देवं पीतकौशेयवाससम्। प्रधानः सोऽस्त्रविदुषां तेन कृष्णेन रक्ष्यते॥
en: The Deity has the mystic mark of Srivatsa, is clad in yellow silken raiment and is the best of those versed in the use of weapons. (Arjuna) is protected by such Krishna.

sa: मुसलालातनाराचतोमरासिपरश्वधैः। अन्विताश्च शतघ्नीभिः समधूच्छिष्टमुद्गराः॥
en: And were armed with maces, fire-brands, Narichas, Tomaras, swords, axes, Shataghnis and clubs saturated with wax.

sa: सहायः पुण्डरीकाक्षः श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः। समानस्यन्दने पार्थमास्थाय परवीरहा॥
en: The graceful, lotus-eyed deity of incomparable prowess, the slayer of hostile heroes in his help and he rides with Partha in the same chariot.

sa: उपगम्याब्रुवन् दीनाः पाण्डवाञ्छरणप्रदान्। एष दुर्योधनो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रः सहानुजः॥
en: Went in grief to the Pandavas who never refuse help to those that ask for it; they thus spoke to them, “Here is king Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra with his brothers.

sa: सुहृदामप्यवाचीनस्त्यक्तधर्मा प्रियानृतः। प्रतिहन्त्येव सुहृदां वाचश्चैव मनांसि च॥
en: He does not listen to even the words of his well-wishers, destitute of virtue, fond of falsehood and always goes against the advice and intentions of his well-wishers.

sa: मुहूर्तमेवमभवद् वलावेगप्रमाथिनोः। सौमित्रेश्च महाबाहोः सम्प्रहारः सुदारुणः॥
en: That furious battle between Vajravega and Pramathin (on one hand) and the mighty-armed son of Sumitra (on the other) lasted for a moment only.

sa: विगाह्य तत् परानीकं गजवाजिरथाकुलम्। शस्त्रप्रतापनिर्वीर्यान् कुरूढिीत्वाऽऽनये पशून्॥
en: Entering into the hostile army filled with elephants, horses and chariots and defeating the Kurus who are weak in power and weapons I shall bring back the animals.

sa: सप्तर्षीणामन्यतमं वेषमास्थाय भारत। बुभुक्षुः क्षुभितो राजन्नाश्रमं कौशिकस्य तु॥
en: Having assumed the appearance of one of the seven Rishis, O Bharata, he came to the hermitage of the son of Kushika, as if hungry, with the desire of satisfying his hunger.

sa: किमब्रवीदमेयात्मा राधेयं परवीरहा। कानि सान्त्वानि गोविन्दः सूतपुत्रे प्रयुक्तवान्॥
en: What did that one god immeasurable soul, that slayer of heroes on the enemy's side, say to the son of Radha? What comforting words did Govinda say to the son of Suta?

sa: संस्थापय पथिष्वस्मांस्तिष्ठ धर्मे सुवर्मनि। आहुश्चमां परिषदं पुत्रास्ते भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Set us in the proper path and follow yourself the excellent path of virtue.' And your sons, O best of the Bharata race, have sent this message to this assembly of kings.

sa: धर्मकामार्थकार्याणि तथा मन्त्रो न भिद्यते। गिरिपृष्ठमुपारुह्य प्रासादं वा रहोगतः॥
en: Let not the intention, to do acts to be done either for virtue, worldly good or gratifying desires, be made known to others. Having ascended the top of a mountain or the roof of a palace.

sa: वश्येन्द्रियं जितात्मानं धृतदण्डं विकारिषु। परीक्ष्य कारिणं धीरमत्यन्तं धीरमत्यन्तं श्रीनिषेवते।।५८
en: Great prosperity comes up on him who has controlled his senses or subjugated himself and who can hold the rod (of punishment) against all offenders without partiality and who acts with circumspection and who is patient.

sa: क्षत्रभावादपगतो ब्राह्मणत्वमुपागतः। धर्मस्य वचनात् प्रीतो विश्वामित्रस्तदाभवत्॥
en: He then became divested of the condition of a Kshatriyas and reached that of a Brahmana and Vishvamitra became pleased at those words Dharma.

sa: तथैव राजा मत्स्यानां विराटो वाहिनीपतिः। पर्वतीयैर्महीपालैः सहितः पाण्डवानियात्॥
en: In the same way did Virata, the king of the Matsya, the leader of an army come to the sons of Pandu, accompanied by a large body of soldiers, inhabiting hilly tracts.

sa: दुर्बुद्धिमकृतप्रज्ञं छन्नं कूपं तृणैरिवा विवर्जयीत मेधावी तस्मिन् मैत्री प्रणश्यति॥
en: And the learning of the former is the same as that of the latter, the friendship between the two person never wears out. One who has a wicked soul, one whose understanding has not been cultivated.

sa: शूरस्तथाप्रतिबलो गौरस्ताल इवोन्नतः। प्रमाणतो भीसेनः प्रादेशेनाधिकोऽर्जुनात्॥
en: A hero of exceedingly white complexion and tall like the palm tree, Bhimasena measures a Prasesha (the span of a thumb) more than Arjuna.

sa: चामृत्युरमृतं मे कुतः स्यात्। सत्यानृते सत्यसमानबन्धे सतश्च योनिरसतश्चैक एवा योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: I am beyond the reach of earthly evils; whence can the death and life come to me? nor am I desirous of emancipation for truth and untruth, good and evil-all rest in the Supreme Being. (Thus does the emancipated soul think within himself). Ascetics perceive that Lord that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: पूर्णात् पूर्णान्युद्धरन्ति पूर्णात् पूर्णानि चक्रिरे। हरन्ति पूर्णात् पूर्णानि पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: Form that which is complete (Brahma) has the complete universe sprung; and from that which is complete have also the conditions which are complete sprung and when those which are full (conditions) are separated from that which is full (Brahma) the true full remains. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is eternal.

sa: तोमरैरभिवर्षन्तौ जीमूताविव वार्षिको। एकैकेन विपाठेन जघ्ने माद्रवतीसुतः॥
en: With two arrows however the son of Madri succeeded in killing those two heroes who had been pouring on him a shower of arrows like clouds in rains.
